abstract: The Drug-Gene Interaction Database (DGIdb; https://dgidb.org) is an open-access aggregate knowledgebase that normalizes and centralizes drug-gene interaction and gene annotation data from diverse therapeutic and biomedical sources. Since its previous update, DGIdb has expanded its data content and added new tooling to better support programmatic access and local deployment. This release updates existing sources and incorporates three new sources of interaction data, including annotation data from the Molecular Oncology Almanac, the PRISM Repurposing Dataset, and the Broad Institute Drug Repurposing Hub. To streamline data access for computational workflows, we have developed dgiPy and dgiR, Python and R client libraries that provide standardized access to the DGIdb API. We additionally now provide versioned Docker images and a public data repository containing current and historical DGIdb data releases in TSV and SQL formats. Together with continued improvements to the web interface, these new resources expand FAIR, transparent, and reproducible access to drug-gene interaction data in the bioinformatics community.
